user.title: Meshtastic UI
user.description: Connect directly to your Meshtastic radio. Choose a connection type.

tcp.title: TCP Connection
tcp.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your Meshtastic radio.

serial.title: Serial Connection
serial.description: Enter the serial device path for your Meshtastic radio.

ble.title: Bluetooth Connection
ble.description: Select a discovered Meshtastic radio, scan for nearby devices, or enter a MAC address manually.

ble_scan.title: Scan for Radios
ble_scan.description: Select a radio found during the scan, scan again, or enter a MAC address manually.

ble_manual.title: Manual Bluetooth Address
ble_manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your Meshtastic radio (e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

zeroconf_confirm.title: Set up Meshtastic radio
zeroconf_confirm.description:
A Meshtastic radio was discovered on the network:

**{name}**
`{host}:{port}`

Do you want to set it up?

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up Meshtastic radio
bluetooth_confirm.description:
A Meshtastic radio was discovered via Bluetooth:

**{name}**
`{address}`

Do you want to set it up?

ble_pin.title: Bluetooth Pairing PIN
ble_pin.description: Connecting to {name} ({address})... Look at your radio's screen for the 6-digit pairing PIN. Enter the PIN shown on your screen (or 123456 if fixed PIN):

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the radio. Check the address and ensure the radio is powered on.
error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be a 6-digit number.
error.pairing_failed: Bluetooth pairing failed. Please verify the radio is on, in range, and the PIN is correct.

abort.bluetooth_disabled: Bluetooth discovery is disabled in options.
